name: Creative Brief Specification
purpose: JSON Schema for projects/<slug>/brief.json: objective, audience, platforms, deliverable formats and duration, message, tone, constraints, provided assets, inspected references, audio needs, whether research is required, and one to three distinct creative directions with the selected direction and rationale.

Forces explicit audio/research decisions instead of assuming narration and a research dossier
